decisions.statement: A page's own file is spelled anew where it exports the type its slug names.
A page's code file is spelled anew where it exports the name its slug makes.
A file exporting neither name is spelled nowhere.
A page stating no code file has no code file spelled.
A name is read as exported from a declaration rather than from an export list.
A body that spells the name nowhere is read no further than that.
Nothing here reaches a change or writes a body.

definition: the exports a page's own files carry under the name that page's slug makes
